defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks meal card (yemek kartı) payment method support
defects.invariant: Waiter send-to-cashier flow must support meal card (Multinet/Sodexo/Ticket) as payment method, matching Cashier capability
defects.mechanism: WaiterPWA bill.js btnSendToCashier (line 192) sends entire check to cashier with no payment method selection; Cashier split-payment.js:16 (pazar-uzmani.md line 8) lacks meal card payment method; waiter cannot initiate meal card payment — requires cashier-side support first, then waiter UI for payment method selection
defects.acceptance: Cashier adds meal card payment method; WaiterPWA send-to-cashier includes payment method selection (or defaults to cashier choice) with meal card option

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks mixed payment (karma ödeme etiketi) support
defects.invariant: Waiter/cashier flow must support split tender (cash + card + meal card) with clear labeling
defects.mechanism: No mixed payment UI in WaiterPWA bill.js or Cashier split-payment.js; pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists as unmentioned scope
defects.acceptance: Cashier split-payment supports multiple tender types per transaction with labeled breakdown; WaiterPWA reflects this in send-to-cashier

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks fiscal receipt (mali fiş) printing flow
defects.invariant: Completed payment must trigger fiscal printer (e-Arşiv/yazarkasa) output, not just info receipt
defects.mechanism: Cashier split-payment.js:1441,1498 produces 'Bilgi Fişi' via window.print (pazar-uzmani.md line 9) — not fiscal; waiter has no fiscal flow; server fiscal integration not verified in code
defects.acceptance: Cashier payment completion triggers fiscal printer service; waiter sees fiscal receipt status

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks X/Z report printing
defects.invariant: Waiter/cashier must be able to print X (interim) and Z (end-of-day) reports with method breakdown
defects.mechanism: Cashier cash-session.js:710-729 lacks X/Z printing (pazar-uzmani.md line 16); WaiterPWA has no reporting UI; pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists as unmentioned
defects.acceptance: Cashier adds X/Z report generation with payment method breakdown; WaiterPWA may surface report access per role

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks package address entry (paket adres girişi) for takeaway
defects.invariant: Takeaway orders must capture customer name/phone/address before sending to kitchen
defects.mechanism: PosTerminal Cashier.tsx:523-567 lacks customer fields for package sale (pazar-uzmani.md line 20); WaiterPWA has no takeaway flow; pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists as unmentioned
defects.acceptance: PosTerminal package sale captures customer details; WaiterPWA takeaway flow (if added) mirrors this

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks table merge (garsonda birleştirme) — duplicate of UI0166
defects.invariant: Same as UI0166 — waiter must merge occupied tables
defects.mechanism: pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists 'garsonda birleştirme' as unmentioned; transfer.js only offers transfer to empty tables

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks loyalty (sadakat) program integration
defects.invariant: Waiter must be able to apply/earn loyalty points during ordering or payment
defects.mechanism: No loyalty UI in WaiterPWA bill.js, menu.js, or api.js; pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists as unmentioned
defects.acceptance: Server loyalty API exposed; WaiterPWA adds loyalty points display/earn/burn in bill and menu

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks gift/waste distinction (hediye/zayı ayrımı)
defects.invariant: Comp (ikram) must be distinguishable from waste (zayı/fire) for accounting
defects.mechanism: WaiterPWA bill.js renderSentLine shows canComp button (line 340) but no waste button; state.js item status includes 'Waste' (bill.js line 77) but no UI to mark waste; pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists as unmentioned
defects.acceptance: WaiterPWA adds waste button for eligible items (kitchenState NotSent), distinct from comp, with server Waste endpoint

defects.title: WaiterPWA lacks scale (terazi) integration for weighted products
defects.invariant: Weighted products (e.g., meat, cheese) must read weight from scale and calculate price
defects.mechanism: No scale integration in WaiterPWA product-sheet.js, api.js, or state.js; pazar-uzmani.md line 25 lists as unmentioned
defects.acceptance: WaiterPWA product sheet integrates with scale hardware/API for weighted products, auto-calculates price

limitations: Multiple distinct defects bundled in one source record; each needs separate task; static review only — server APIs for meal card, fiscal, X/Z, loyalty, scale not examined; PosTerminal gaps (package address, X/Z) also block waiter features
review_tier: Child static-source draft; parent ID/ref validation passed; independent semantics pending
